title: A double click on Move moves the customers once
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • Scenario: Your shop moves two customers to Net 45, and the move button gets a quick double click.
  • You are an Admin user working at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • COD is the shop's default for new customers.
  • The shop's own term {Term-A}, due 20 days after the invoice date, is held by exactly two customers, {Customer-A} and {Customer-B}.
    For example: {Term-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S4-18 N20, {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S4-18 Alpha and {Customer-B} is ZZAUTOTEST S4-18 Bravo.
  • Starting screen: the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group), Active tab.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the "⋯" at the right of the {Term-A} row.
  2. Click "Move Customers".
  3. Choose "Net 45" in "Move To".
  4. Double-click "Move 2 Customers" quickly.
  5. Open {Customer-A}'s Notes tab.
  6. On the Credit Terms page, open the "⋯" page menu.
  7. Click "Audit Log".
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the menu opens.
  • Step 2: a window titled "Move Customers from {Term-A}" opens.
  • Step 3: the button reads "Move 2 Customers".
  • Step 4: the button is disabled while saving; one toast "2 customers moved to Net 45." shows.
  • Step 5: there is exactly one new move note.
  • Step 6: the menu opens.
  • Step 7: exactly one new "Customers moved" row reads "2 customers from {Term-A} to Net 45".

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11673 (Story 4, Move Customers), story SV-11681 (Story 12, Credit Terms audit log)

  • S4-R21: “"Move {n} Customers" and "Set Limits to $0 and Move" are disabled while the move is saving, so a double click moves once.”
  • S12-R3 table, customers moved: “Customers are moved (Story 4: Move Customers) | "Customers moved" | "{n} customers from {from} to {to}" ("1 customer from {from} to {to}" for one), followed by "Credit limit set to $0 (previous limits are in each customer's note)" when the target is COD or Credit Hold”
